geographic_coverage: Citywide, all five boroughs; 53,986 line features (ArcGIS row count 2026-09-13, E5; matches metadata object count 53986, E3). Metadata Description (E3, verbatim): 'Citywide street center-line features representing official street names and widths shown on the Official City Map of New York City. Features include paper streets gathered from Borough Final Section maps (except Staten Island). Alteration Maps, Zoning Maps and street name index cards on archive in the Technical Review Division at the Department of City Planning. Record streets and unmapped streets are included in this dataset for context and informational purposes only.' fields_available.note: 18 fields on layer 0, live-verified 2026-09-13 (E5). Geometry esriGeometryPolyline; spatialReference wkid 102718 / latestWkid 2263 = EPSG:2263 (NAD83 New York-Long Island State Plane, US survey feet) - byte-verified in the official metadata Spatial Reference block (E3) and live on the service (E5). Output formats 'JSON, geoJSON, PBF' and supportsPagination true (E5). NOTE the per-channel field-name divergence vs the SODA companion: ArcGIS carries Feat_status / Streetwidth / RoadwayType / Build_Status where SODA truncates to feat_statu / streetwidt / roadway_typ / build_stat - a connector must map from the live schema of whichever channel it queries, never assume names across channels (S4 cross-channel finding).

field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Streetwidth: STRING(50). NO field-level definition text is present in the official metadata for this field (only alias/type/width) - the ONLY authoritative characterization of the width concept is the dataset Summary/Description phrase 'official street names and widths shown on the Official City Map of New York City' (E3). The Official-City-Map framing = the legally MAPPED street width (as distinct from paved/roadbed width); empirically corroborated (E6: West 100 St Manhattan = 60, vs Geoclient/LION paved 30). The exact geometric definition (mapped right-of-way / property-line-to-property-line vs bed width) is NOT spelled out at field level = OQ-1. The field is FREE TEXT: observed domain (E7) includes clean integers ('60','80','100'), decimals ('49.5'), ranges ('50-60','60-75','75-90'), inequalities ('>75','>80','<60'), approximations ('~60','~80'), prose ('Around 60','More or less 40','Probably between 80 - 90','Regular but unknown.'), 'Width Irregular' (45), 'n/a' (2954), and 'Unknown'/'Unknown but <75'/'Unknown but >75' (1404+). Units are feet where numeric. A connector MUST parse conservatively and fail closed - never parse-and-guess.
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Feat_Type: STRING(50). 'The street line type from the City Map, indicating if the street centerline is a mapped or unmapped street.' Domain: Former_St, Mapped_St, Not_mapped (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Feat_statu: STRING(50). No field-level description captured in metadata (E3). Observed values 'City_St'/'Paper_St'/'Way_on_record'/'Demapped' on live samples (E1; M4-T015 live re-check 2026-09-13). Value domain = OQ-2, still open (no published coded-value domain on the live layer schema). M4-T015 FINDING: 'Way_on_record' was observed co-occurring with Record_ST='N' on the SAME live feature (Sharrott Avenue OBJECTID 20420) - proof that Feat_status is INDEPENDENT of the Record_ST/Paper_ST flags and must never be used as a proxy for them.
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Street_NM: STRING(100). 'Name of the street or right of way on record at local borough topographic office.' (E3). Not a stable join key: width varies per segment of one named street, so determinations are per-segment/per-geometry, never per street name (S2/S4).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.HonoraryNM: STRING(100). 'A co-name, or additional but secondary name, given to an official street name through Local Law legislation.' (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Old_ST_NM: STRING(254). 'After a street name is officially changed through a street renaming, the old name is archived in this field.' (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Route_Type: STRING(50). 'Route type shown on the Master Plan of Arterial Highways and Major Streets referenced in Appendix H of NYC Zoning Resolution.' Domain: Arterial, Former_ROW, General_use, Major_street, Other (E3). Directly ZR-relevant (Appendix H) but distinct from the wide/narrow width test.
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Record_ST: STRING(50). 'Flag that indicates if the right of way is a record street shown on the City Map. A record street is a type of unmapped street that was recorded at local Borough President's topographic offices and is displayed on the City Map and Zoning Map. New unmapped streets are not recorded and displayed on the City Map or Zoning Map.' Metadata PDF states Value: yes = record street (E3), BUT M4-T015 live re-check (2026-09-13) observes the ACTUAL ArcGIS value domain is single-letter 'Y'/'N' (e.g. Woodvale Avenue OBJECTID 16549 Record_ST='Y'), not the lowercase word 'yes' - same metadata-vs-live discrepancy as Paper_ST; a connector must match the LIVE 'Y'/'N' domain.
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.RoadwayTyp: STRING(50). No field-level description captured in metadata (E3). Observed value 'Surface_ST' on live samples (E1). Domain = OQ-2 (still open - no coded-value domain is published on the live layer schema for this field either, M4-T015 live re-check 2026-09-13).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Build_Stat: STRING(50). No field-level description captured in the s-media metadata PDF (E3). M4-T015 REFINEMENT (2026-09-13, live layer/query field schema, not the static PDF): this field DOES carry a published ArcGIS coded-value domain 'DCMSCL_route_status_1' = {Improved, Part_improved, Unimproved, Not_applicable (code 'n/a')} - partially resolving OQ-2 for this field specifically; Feat_statu and RoadwayTyp remain genuinely undocumented (domain: null in the same live schema).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Paper_ST: STRING(50). 'Flag that indicates if feature is a paper street. A paper street is a street that is officially mapped but is not physically built and only appears on paper on the Official City Map.' Metadata PDF states Value: yes (E3), BUT M4-T015 live re-check (2026-09-13) observes the ACTUAL ArcGIS value domain is single-letter 'Y'/'N' (e.g. Jay Place OBJECTID 599 Paper_ST='Y'), not the lowercase word 'yes' - a genuine metadata-vs-live discrepancy; a connector must match the LIVE 'Y'/'N' domain, never the PDF's prose value. Legal treatment of paper streets must come from the ZR text, not assumption (S2 caveat).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Stair_ST: STRING(50). 'Flag that indicates if feature is a stair street. A stair street is a street segment that contains steps or stairs to accommodate foot traffic.' Value: yes (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.CCO_ST: STRING(50). 'Non city-owned street made eligible for public use and capital improvements through a Corporation Counsel Opinion (CCO) of Dedication.' Value: yes (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Marg_Wharf: STRING(50). 'A designated area on or near the waterfront under the jurisdiction of Small Business Services (SBS) and displayed as "Marginal Street, Wharf or Place". It is not the same as an official street but is shown on the City Map.' Value: yes (E3).
field_definitions_byte_verified_from_met.Edit_Date: DATE. 'The date the record was last edited.' (E3).

connector_implementation: IMPLEMENTED (M4-T015, D-045-R003 B2): services/api/app/connectors/dcm_street_centerline_arcgis.py (SOURCE_ID self-declaration 'nyc-dcp-dcm-street-centerline-arcgis' matches this record) + services/api/app/connectors/dcm_street_width_classifier.py (pure classifier, no I/O). Allowlisted per-segment/per-area queries only (exact Borough/Street_NM equality or OBJECTID/OBJECTID-IN equality; a caller can never supply raw SQL); pinned service root; bounded outFields subset (never '*'); deterministic paging via orderByFields=OBJECTID ASC + resultOffset honoring exceededTransferLimit with loop-safety guarantees (duplicate-page / repeated-OBJECTID / zero-progress / hard page-count ceiling, each a typed paging_pathology, never an infinite loop or silent truncation); CRS validated (wkid 102718/2263) BEFORE any field is trusted; HTTP-200 ArcGIS error-object trap (typed upstream_error, never data); single bounded attempt per request, NO retry loop (the M5-T020 bounded no-retry posture). Width classification: the typed free-text parser classifies wide ONLY on mathematical entailment >=75 ft (clean numeral/decimal, both-endpoints range, or one-sided inequality whose bound is >=75); every other class fails closed to narrow_fail_closed with a typed ambiguity class + review flag (OQ-3 stays unresolved - no ZR-grounded legal judgment is made). ADDITIONAL connector-level rule (S3): a segment that is not Feat_Type='Mapped_St', or that is flagged Paper_ST='Y'/Record_ST='Y', NEVER classifies wide regardless of the width text (effective_classification, kept separate from the untouched raw width_classification). Recorded-official fixtures: services/api/tests/fixtures/dcm_street_centerline/ (25 live-captured + 1 documented-synthetic HTTP-200-error-object shape); fully offline contract tests in services/api/tests/connectors/test_dcm_street_centerline_arcgis.py + test_dcm_street_width_classifier.py. NOT in scope: consumer wiring into rules/profile/API, the SODA fallback channel (not queried by this connector), Geoclient cross-check, and the OQ-4 within-100-ft geometry computation.

known_limitations: Streetwidth is FREE TEXT, not numeric: ranges/inequalities/approximations/prose/'Width Irregular'/'n/a'/'Unknown' all occur (E7). Values straddling the ZR 75-ft threshold ('75','>75','60-75','74-75.3','75-90','Unknown but <75','Unknown but >75') are the highest-stakes cases and several are irreducibly ambiguous - parse conservatively, fail closed to narrow, never guess.

The width concept is characterized only at dataset level ('widths shown on the Official City Map'); no field-level definition in metadata (OQ-1). The mapped-width interpretation rests on that framing + empirical divergence from paved width; byte-verify against the Official City Map / borough final-section source during full validation.
Width varies per segment of one named street (West 100 St Manhattan: 60 and 100, E6) - determinations are per-segment/per-lot geometry, never per street name.

Paper streets (Paper_ST=yes), unmapped/record streets (Feat_Type Not_mapped, Record_ST=yes), stair streets, marginal-wharf features and CCO streets are all present - each needs an explicit ZR-grounded treatment, not a default.

Horizontal accuracy: the DCM metadata gives no explicit tolerance for this layer; the sibling DCP GIS products state +/- 20 ft (zoning-features / MapPLUTO). Near-75-ft-boundary and within-100-ft conclusions are uncertain by the source's own informational-only posture.
maxRecordCount 2000 (E5) rules this out as a citywide bulk mirror; per-segment/per-area queries only (thin client).

Field-name divergence between the ArcGIS channel (Feat_status/Streetwidth/RoadwayType/Build_Status) and the SODA companion (feat_statu/streetwidt/roadway_typ/build_stat) - map from the live schema of the queried channel.

open_questions: OQ-1: byte-verify the exact geometric definition of the mapped width (right-of-way / property-line-to-property-line vs bed) against the Official City Map / borough final-section source; the field carries no metadata definition.
OQ-2: value domains for Feat_statu, RoadwayTyp, Build_Stat (metadata lists no domain; live samples show City_St / Surface_ST / Improved).
OQ-3: full free-text-width domain enumeration + the ZR-grounded classification/fail-closed policy (a rule/legal task, not a data task) for ambiguous, irregular, paper, and unmapped segments.

OQ-4: the within-100-ft-of-a-wide-street, any-portion-of-lot geometry computation (DCM line geometry x lot geometry x 100-ft buffer) is a separate downstream task; a fronting-street width alone cannot answer ZR 23-22 footnote 1.
